tagline: REPLACE: one line under the title: what participants can do after the course
description: Participants practise the architect's loop on AI systems and apply it to the shared platform many teams build on. For a fictional ministry of municipal services with nine product teams and data at three classification levels, they turn requirements into measurable scenarios, draw views as code, cost three options including a non-generative one, keep a decision log, design a model catalogue, gateway, tenancy model, golden paths and showback, enforce a reference design with fitness checks, and review a peer's architecture. Serving optimisation and reliability engineering are left to AE-401 and AE-403.
audience: Specialists. Engineers who have completed the level 300 core or can show equivalent work: a production AI system they built, operated and can defend.
prerequisites: AE-305 Operating Machine Learning and Language Model Systems
AE-308 Securing Language Model and Agent Applications
AE-311 Shaping the Build: Product Sense and Delivery Practice
Has built and deployed at least one AI service that other people used
Reads a cloud usage export or bill
Can name the four national data classification levels

outcomes.text: Prepare quality-attribute scenarios with measurable targets for answer quality, latency, cost, privacy and human oversight, given the case brief, three interview notes and the data inventory
outcomes.evidence: a scenario sheet a reviewer can test a design against

outcomes.text: Design an end-to-end architecture with context, container and data-flow views and a per-request latency and cost budget, given the scenario sheet and the classification of each data flow
outcomes.evidence: an architecture document with views as code and one request traced end to end

outcomes.text: Evaluate at least three solution options, including a non-generative baseline, and record the resulting decisions, given weighted criteria, a three-year volume forecast and price ranges
outcomes.evidence: an options paper with total cost, lock-in and sensitivity analysis, and at least six decision records

outcomes.text: Design a shared AI platform covering model admission, gateway, tenancy, golden paths and cost attribution, given nine teams, three classification levels, synthetic usage logs and invoices
outcomes.evidence: a design and a working slice whose gateway refuses restricted data to an external model and whose showback reconciles within 2%

outcomes.text: Design a reference architecture with fitness functions that check conformance automatically, given a recurring pattern: retrieval over classified documents
outcomes.evidence: a template and two automated checks that fail on a non-conforming design

outcomes.text: Review a peer's architecture with a structured trade-off method and decide on a requested deviation, given a peer design, the reference designs and a deviation request
outcomes.evidence: a review report naming risks, sensitivity points and non-compliance, with a recorded decision
